description: This Java class serves as a wrapper around the ShareAccountRepository, providing methods to retrieve and save ShareAccount entities with not-found detection.

classes.name: ShareAccountRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A Spring service component that wraps ShareAccountRepository to provide entity retrieval with exception handling and persistence methods.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Retrieves a ShareAccount by ID, throwing an exception if the account is not found.

methods.name: saveAndFlush
methods.description: Saves the ShareAccount and immediately flushes changes to the database.
